::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/coupons/{cpn}/stats"}
#docs
discount_gross is the discount taken off invoices; discount_reversed is the share of it credited back by non-voided credit notes; discount_given = gross − reversed.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cpn` | `string` | **yes** | The coupon's id (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `coupon_stats`. One of `coupon_stats`. |
| `coupon` | `string` | The coupon's id (a slug id, e.g. `welcome-10`). |
| `redemptions` | `integer` | Every application, set codes included; removed ones still count |
| `discount_given` | `array of object` | Net of credit notes: discount_gross − discount_reversed |
| `discount_gross` | `array of object` | Discount taken off non-voided invoices |
| `discount_reversed` | `array of object` | Share of the discount reversed by non-voided credit notes: a note item linked to an invoice line reverses that line's discount pro rata; an unlinked note reverses the invoice's discount by its share of the invoice total |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such coupon |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/coupons/welcome-10/stats" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
